payload.core_mechanism_summary: Simulate game for each possible t using prefix-sum arrays to jump to next set, then sort valid (s,t) pairs.
payload.rationale: Main logic is simulation with O(1) jumps via precomputed counts. Sorting is only for output ordering, not the core algorithm. None of the given sorting subtypes accurately capture the solution's essence; sorting_custom_key is selected as the least inappropriate among candidates.
